context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 73 verified Domain Blocklist Management feature: 1) All 4 API endpoints working correctly with admin authentication. 2) QualityScoreAnalytics component displays Blocked Domains section with count and Show/Hide toggle. 3) Improvement Opportunities section shows low-quality domains with individual block buttons. 4) Block All button appears when there are improvement opportunities. 5) Current data shows 'All content meets quality standards' so no domains to block. 6) Previous features (Quality Score Analytics, Quality Score Filtering) continue to work.

GET_blocked_domains_API.details: GET /api/admin/blocked-domains returns 200 with blocked_domains array and total_blocked count. Requires admin authentication (401 without auth, 403 for non-admin).

POST_blocked_domain_API.details: POST /api/admin/blocked-domains adds domain to blocklist, removes associated search results, returns success with results_removed count. Rejects duplicate domains with 400.

DELETE_blocked_domain_API.details: DELETE /api/admin/blocked-domains/{domain} removes domain from blocklist. Returns 404 for non-existent domains.

POST_bulk_block_API.details: POST /api/admin/blocked-domains/bulk blocks multiple domains at once, skips already blocked domains, returns blocked_count, skipped_count, and total_results_removed.

QualityScoreAnalytics_UI.details: QualityScoreAnalytics component found with data-testid='quality-score-analytics'. Shows Blocked Domains section, Improvement Opportunities section, Top Quality Domains, Quality Score Distribution.

Blocked_Domains_Section.details: Blocked Domains section displays count (0) with Show/Hide toggle button. When expanded, shows list of blocked domains with Unblock buttons.

Improvement_Opportunities_Section.details: Improvement Opportunities section displays low-quality domains. Currently shows 'All content meets quality standards!' because no low-quality domains exist.

Previous_Features_Stability.details: Health, Auth, Categories, Admin Stats, Marketplace Leaderboard, Quality Analytics API all working correctly.

mocked_apis.note: All APIs return real data from MongoDB
